colour.description: A colour: a name in this recipe's `palette`.

cosmetic.description: A cosmetic: `body` and `eyes` parts drawn on one of the character's slots, in the slot's local units (the slot point is (0, 0), up is −y; on `headTop` a hat has 40 units of height). It moves with the slot: the pose, the head turn, the hop.

category.description: What kind of thing it is, for grouping in a picker (FX Spec 1.13, design note 25): `hat`, `glasses`, `scarf`, `badge`, `frame`, `effect` or `other`.

fit.description: Per character, a nudge: `at` (local units), `scale` and `angle` on top of the character's slot.

fits.description: The characters it is made for; any other doesn't wear it. Without it, every character with the slot wears it.

id.description: Its name: 1–32 of a–z, 0–9 and -, unique in the list. Its colours are `<id>.<name>` in the palette, so `palette` repaints them.

label.description: What it is, for people ("party hat").

palette.description: Its own colours, by name, `[hue, saturation, lightness]`. Its parts name them; they hide the character's colour of the same name. Its parts may also name the character's colours.

parts.description: What it draws, back to front, on top of the character: `body` (with its layers) and `eyes`, without `space` or `surface`. Left out at 20 px unless `accessories` is on, or a part says `when`.

slot.description: The slot it sits on: `headTop`, `face`, `neck` or `chest` (or a slot a custom recipe names). A character without that slot doesn't wear it.

cosmetic-body.description: A shape filled with its light, its inner layers clipped to it, and an outline. `turnLight` `[dx, k]` moves a radial light as the body turns. `"light": "none"` (and no stops) draws only the layers: an overlay that adds soft layers over a part that has none (BUZZY's helmet).

inner.description: Layers clipped to the body: `patch`, `band`, `stripes`, `glints`, `grille`, `shade`, `rim` or `eyes`.

allOf.description: `{ "radial": [cx, cy, r] }`, or an ellipse `[cx, cy, rx, ry, angle]` (radians; the centre stays put while the body turns under it), `{ "linear": [x0, y0, x1, y1] }`, or `"none"` (an overlay: no fill).

stops.description: The light's gradient: `[[offset 0–1, colour], …]`, each with an optional alpha `[offset, colour, alpha]`; any number of stops.

width.description: The outline width (scaled with the character's line weight).

shape.description: A shape: `{ "ellipse": [cx, cy, rx, ry, rotation, segments] }`, `{ "roundRect": [x, y, w, h, radius, step] }` or `{ "path": "M… Z" }` (an SVG path with `M L H V C S Q T Z`; later subpaths are holes).

show.description: How visible it is per voice state, 0–1: `{ idle, listening, thinking, speaking }`; a state left out is 0. Absent: always, at its own alpha.

turnLight.description: How the radial light moves as the body turns: `[dx, k]`.

when.description: `notSmallOrAccessories`: left out at 20 px with `accessories` off. Absent: always drawn.

cosmetic-eyes.description: The shared eyes: they blink, look round, follow the voice state and take the expression. A part on its own (in `face` space) or a body layer.

glow.description: A glow round the eyes, 0–1: one number, or `[at 64 and 32 px, at 20 px]`.

ink.description: The ink colour (a palette name); effects tint it.

iris.description: The glossy eye's iris colour (a palette name). Absent: teal.

scale.description: Its size: `[at 64 and 32 px, at 20 px]`.

sclera.description: The glossy eye has a white sclera and a dark lid line instead of a dark lens.

show.description: How visible it is per voice state, 0–1: `{ idle, listening, thinking, speaking }`; a state left out is 0. Absent: always, at its own alpha.

shape.description: A shape: `{ "ellipse": [cx, cy, rx, ry, rotation, segments] }`, `{ "roundRect": [x, y, w, h, radius, step] }` or `{ "path": "M… Z" }` (an SVG path with `M L H V C S Q T Z`; later subpaths are holes).

path.description: An SVG path: M L H V C S Q T Z (no arcs; `fitPath` in @sinua/snippets converts them), in the 200-unit box. Later subpaths are holes.

description: A character as data (FX Spec 1.12 `recipe`; spec/characters/*.json), and the cosmetics it wears (1.13 `cosmetics`). Generated from the engine's tables: do not edit; see docs/character-recipe.md.

$comment.description: A note for people. Ignored by the engine.

$schema.description: The schema URL, for editors: https://sinua.dev/schema/character-recipe-1.json. Ignored by the engine.

burst.description: The celebrate burst: `at`, `r` and three `colors` (palette names), optionally a `space`.

contrast.description: `[[ink, ground], …]`: a face colour and the colour it sits on. A `palette` override that brings the ground too close lifts the ink.

cosmetics.description: Cosmetics the character always wears (FX Spec 1.13): the same objects as an FX Spec file's `cosmetics`. A file's `cosmetics` come after these.

grain.description: `{ "strength": 0–1 }`: film grain inside every body (FX Spec 1.13, design note 22), a fine, still noise of light and dark specks; 0.08 is a good start. The `grain` option overrides it. Left out at 20 px and under low power; the face stays crisp.

hue.description: `base`: the hue the palette is drawn at (the default `hue` option); `turns`: the colour names the `hue` option rotates.

id.description: The character's name: 1–32 of a–z, 0–9 and -. An FX Spec file's `pattern` names it.

palette.description: The colours, by name: each `[hue 0–360, saturation 0–1, lightness 0–1]`. Parts name these; they are also the slots `palette` repaints. `celebrate` is reserved for the burst.

parts.description: What is drawn, back to front: up to 48 parts, a body's inner layers included.

profile.description: The built-in character whose voice-state behaviour it borrows (how it turns, looks and moves per state). Without it, the shared `character` profile.

rig.description: How the whole character moves: `pivot` (leans and squashes round a point), `upright` (stands on `base`) or `float` (drifts round `center`).

roles.description: Which palette slot plays each role, `{ "primary": "<slot>", "secondary": "<slot>", "accent": "<slot>" }` (FX Spec 1.13): a named palette (`"palette": "sunset"`) or a brand colour (`{ "primary": "#E63946" }`) reaches the character through it. A role left out isn't repainted.

slots.description: Named anchor points for cosmetics: `at`, and the chain it `follows` (`head`, `body` or `face`), with an optional `scale` and `angle` that size and turn a cosmetic for this character. `headTop`, `face`, `neck` and `chest` are the standard names cosmetics look for.

surfaces.description: Named spheres or cylinders (`c`, `r`, `depth`, `cylinder`) that face parts are drawn on, so they wrap round when the head turns. `face` is the usual one.
